definition: Approach coping is a way of responding to a difficult situation by moving toward it rather than away from it, such as through problem-focused efforts like believing the group can be effective or emotion-focused engagement like group-based anger. In this source, it is described as having both problem-focused and emotion-focused pathways that can help motivate collective action.
